title: EC-Council NDE
summary: EC-Council NDE is a professional certification offered by EC-Council. This independent study guide covers all 12 course modules: Network Security Fundamentals, Identification, Authentication, and Authorization, Network Security Controls - Administrative Controls, Network Security Controls - Physical Controls, Network Security Controls - Technical Controls, Virtualization and Cloud Computing, Wireless Network Security, Mobile Device Security, IoT Device Security, Cryptography and PKI, Data Security, Network Traffic Monitoring. Every module has a MEDIUM and a HARD scenario exam, written as realistic workplace situations rather than recall questions, so you practise applying each module the way the job asks for it.
attributionNote: EC-Council certification content is an independent study guide written for Cyber Pulse Academy and is not affiliated with or endorsed by EC-Council.
